name: Broad bean (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Broad bean (Vicia faba) [Pulses] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DUKE, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 170343 (Broadbeans/fava beans, mature seeds, raw)
Dhull et al. 2022, Legume Science, doi:10.1002/leg3.129 (starch, sugars review)
Faba bean feedstuff review PMC8441412 (amino acids g/kg DM, oligosaccharides)
Multari et al. mono/oligosaccharide survey, ScienceDirect 030881468690004X
Carbohydrate composition of mature/immature faba seeds, ScienceDirect S0889157516300679
Genetic and metabolite variability in Vicia faba, MDPI Plants 2023, PMC9967272 (organic acids)
Vicine/convicine/L-DOPA distribution, ScienceDirect S2772391724000148; Springer doi:10.1007/s00217-008-0876-0
provenance.curation_notes: Curated as the mature raw seed. Dominant carbon/energy source is STARCH (~33 g/100g), followed by sucrose (~2.2 g) plus the raffinose-family alpha-galactosides verbascose/stachyose/raffinose (~3.8 g combined); free glucose and fructose are negligible in mature seed. High protein (26 g) makes the amino-acid pool a major nitrogen/carbon source (Glu, Asp, Arg dominant). Organic acids (oxalic > lactic ~ gluconic > malic; no citric/succinic/fumaric detected) were entirely missing from the FooDB profi
curation_added: verbascose, stachyose, raffinose (RFO alpha-galactosides) with amounts
organic acids: oxalic, lactic, gluconic, malic (were entirely absent; relative amounts only)
quantitative amino-acid profile (18 amino acids, USDA)
quantitative minerals (Fe, Mg, P, K, Zn, Cu, Mn, Se) and vitamins (B1/B2/B3/B5/B6/B9/C/E/K, choline) with amounts
corrected fatty acids (linoleic dominant, palmitic, oleic, ALA) with amounts

curation_removed.name: Arsenate
curation_removed.reason: toxic non-nutritive trace contaminant, not a growth nutrient

curation_removed.name: Cholesterol
curation_removed.reason: animal sterol, biologically implausible in a plant seed; FooDB predicted. Plant sterols (beta-sitosterol, campesterol, stigmasterol) are the real seed sterols and are kept as uncovered

curation_removed.name: Retinol
curation_removed.reason: preformed (animal) vitamin A; plants supply provitamin-A carotenoids not retinol. USDA vitamin A here derives from carotenoids

curation_removed.name: Pentadecanoic acid
curation_removed.reason: odd-chain C15:0 fatty acid characteristic of ruminant/dairy fat; implausible/negligible in a legume seed, FooDB predicted noise

curation_removed.name: Heptanoate
curation_removed.reason: C7:0 short odd-chain fatty acid; implausible in bean seed lipid, FooDB predicted noise

curation_removed.name: D-Serine
curation_removed.reason: D-enantiomer is a mis-assignment; the seed protein residue and free pool is L-serine (retained in components)

curation_removed.name: Nickel
curation_removed.reason: non-nutritive trace element, unquantified FooDB entry; not a growth-defining nutrient of this food

curation_removed.name: Co2+
curation_removed.reason: free cobalt ion, unquantified trace; FooDB noise (retain only as ultra-trace if a B12-cofactor need is modeled)

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
